summary: Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendix A, and checked all eight estimates against their cited PDF pages using PyMuPDF. The four GenAI-versus-baseline coefficients, 89% credible intervals, and Bayes factors match Tables 1-4 and the corresponding results text on PDF pp. 8-10. The extraction correctly distinguishes total effects from the excluded models adjusted for post-treatment time on task, fluency, or variety. Table/prose discrepancies, the printed negative posterior SD in Table 3, and the conflicting conclusion are already documented; they are not transcription errors. The four GenAI-versus-Image-Search comparisons are described without numerical pairwise estimates, so null statistics and se_basis=not_reported are appropriate. The study cohort of 60 is printed, but analysis-specific arm counts and two-arm observation totals are not explicitly printed; the null estimate counts comply with the no-computation rule. Question, construct, measure, analysis unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person status, comparison type, and uncertainty basis agree with the methods and codebook. No additional eligible outcome or contrast was found. Self-reports in Appendix A, within-GenAI associations, non-AI contrasts, and mediator-adjusted models are correctly excluded.
